metadata.title: Grade 6 National A+++ High-Rigor Extension Curriculum — Additional 30 Weeks
metadata.relationship_to_existing_curriculum: This file is designed to continue the user's existing 6-week Grade 6 high-rigor curriculum. It begins at Week 7 and preserves the existing emphasis on systems, evidence, quantitative reasoning, inquiry, communication, creativity, and transfer.
metadata.important_note: The United States has no single federally mandated Grade 6 curriculum. This is therefore a national high-rigor synthesis rather than an official federal curriculum. It deliberately draws from national frameworks and strong state-level examples, then raises the cognitive demand through transfer, justification, source evaluation, data analysis, design, and interdisciplinary performance.
rigor_design: Grade-level mastery plus carefully selected honors-level extension

national_benchmark_research.research_conclusion: No defensible source establishes a single 'highest' sixth-grade curriculum nationwide. The stronger approach is to synthesize the most rigorous common national expectations with demanding state frameworks and then raise the task level through honors-style transfer, evidence, modeling, and interdisciplinary performance.

assessment_philosophy.mastery_target: 80% minimum with targeted reteaching; A+++ distinction at 90%+ overall plus successful capstone defense.
assessment_philosophy.advanced_target: Students justify methods, compare strategies, evaluate evidence limitations, identify assumptions, and transfer concepts to unfamiliar contexts.
